lines.en: Hi Omar! I heard you finally launched your online store. Congratulations!
Hi Sara. Thank you. Little did I know that my small online shop would one day become a real business.
What separates a successful startup from a failing one, in your experience?
It is rarely the idea itself, but the way it is carried out. And knowing which risks are worth taking.
It is believed that most new businesses fail within three years. Were you afraid?
Terrified. Had I listened to my fears, I would never have started at all.
How are people hearing about your store?
Mostly advertising. What makes an advertisement memorable is rarely its budget, but the story it tells.
That is true. Not only do advertisers sell products, but they also sell dreams and lifestyles.
However careful you are, it is almost impossible to escape advertisements these days.
What we should teach children is not to avoid media, but to question it.
Speaking of fairness, a competitor copied my product photos last week. I was furious.
Did you take any legal action?
Not yet. It is a basic principle that everyone is innocent until proven guilty, so I am collecting evidence first.
However strict the law may be, it means little if it is not applied equally to everyone.
Exactly. What makes a society just is not the number of its laws, but the fairness with which they are applied.
You sound calmer about it now.
I learned something. The more we understand our own anger, the less power it has over us.
However confident someone appears, they may be fighting battles nobody knows about. That includes you.
It was only after months of stress that I finally learned to ask for help.
What people need most is the feeling that they are not alone. We are here for you.
Thank you. On a lighter note, did you watch the final last night?
Of course! Not until the final minute did the team score the goal that made them champions.
Little did anyone expect that the youngest player on the field would decide the match.
What the fans will remember is not the score, but the moment the whole stadium stood up.
However talented a player may be, no one wins a team game alone.
Just like business, apparently. Nobody builds a company alone either.
You are right. Losing is painful, but it teaches you lessons that victory never could.
To new beginnings, then. I am proud of you, Omar.
And I am grateful for friends like you, Sara. See you at the next match!
